SEO Technical Audit · Media Buyer Perspective

# Atlas Copco USA  
SEO Audit

Complete SEO audit for Atlas Copco's B2B industrial site in the US. Crawlability, content, structured data, international SEO, and impact on the buyer journey. External analysis — no Search Console access.

5,614 URLs in US sitemap

188 Locale sitemaps

157 Hreflang tags per page

12 Issues found · 5 critical

Quick Context

## What is SEO?

ENGINEER Searches Google "air compressor USA" ORGANIC (SEO) Free traffic · No cost per click PAID (ADS) Paid traffic · Cost per click ATLAS COPCO GOAL: #1 First result on Google

SEO = being the first result when someone searches for what we sell. No cost per click.

Executive Summary

## Overall Health: SOLID

Excellent technical foundations: SSL/TLS 1.3, Cloudflare CDN, 188 locale sitemaps, full hreflang, correct canonicals. **Critical issues are in the content surface layer** (empty H1, generic titles, poor meta descriptions) and **subdomain fragmentation**.

!

Key Insight for Media Buyers

SEO and Paid Media are complementary. SEO reduces long-term CPC — an optimized site improves Ad Quality Score. **SEO is an investment, not an expense.**

CRAWLABILITY Good ✅ INDEXATION Good ✅ ON-PAGE Needs work ⚠️ SCHEMA Needs work ⚠️

#### Performance Proxy — Predictive Analysis

Without PageSpeed API access, we estimate 50-65 mobile based on the tech stack (AEM + Algolia + OneTrust + GTM + Adobe Analytics). Core Web Vitals have been a Google ranking factor since 2021. LCP above 2.5s penalizes all pages. **Recommendation:** Audit with WebPageTest (free) and prioritize non-critical JS optimization.

The SERP Advantage

## With vs Without  
Schema Markup

Rich snippets increase CTR by 20-30%. Here is what our search results look like today vs what they could look like.

Products - Atlas Copco USA www.atlascopco.com/en-us/compressors/products Atlas Copco compressor products... energy efficient compressed air and gas equipment. TEXT ONLY

⬅ CURRENT: No rich snippet

COMPRESSOR IMAGE ZH 630+ Oil-Free Compressor www.atlascopco.com/.../zh-630-plus High-efficiency oil-free centrifugal compressor • 630 kW • Class 0 ★★★★☆ RICH SNIPPET

➡ WITH Product Schema

30% more clicks with the rich snippet. Competitors already use this.

Architecture Issue

## Subdomain Fragmentation

www.atlascopco.com Main site · Authority = 100% shopct. Separate site for Google digitalcatalog. Separate site for Google originair. Separate site for Google Each subdomain = a separate website in Google's eyes Authority from the main site does NOT pass to subdomains

CURRENT

### Fragmented

Multiple subdomains: shopct, digitalcatalog, originair. Each treated as a separate site.

RECOMMENDED

### Consolidated

One unified structure: www.atlascopco.com/shop/, www.atlascopco.com/catalog/

FAQ

## Questions  
everyone asks

Isn't SEO dead?

No. Google processes more signals than ever (Core Web Vitals, E-E-A-T, AI Overviews). But the fundamentals remain: relevant content + healthy site + authority. Atlas Copco's 150-year reputation gives us a huge advantage — the content just needs to be found.

How long until we see results?

Technical fixes (H1, meta descriptions): 2-4 weeks. New content and schema: 3-6 months. Subdomain consolidation: 6-12 months. SEO is a long-term asset — cost per organic lead goes to zero over time.

SEO vs Google Ads — why both?

They are complementary. Together they take 2/3 of the mobile screen. Good SEO improves Quality Score — reducing CPC by 12-18% based on industry studies.

Limited budget — what can we do?

The 4 P1 fixes cost almost nothing: H1 (1 dev hour), meta description (10 min), title (30 min), schema via GTM (1 day). This solves ~60% of the problems with minimal investment.
